title: SSM One Document Catalogue - Auto-Drafting, Audit and Native Upload Rules
status: Optimized target/reference, not deployment or a database seed
original_source_status: Original source inventory is not included in this planning library; source-block IDs and family mappings are retained here.

folder_group_rules.Common & Standards: Approved company and department standards, policies, SOPs, controlled blank templates, plus the department-organized shared audit/QMS index and non-project audit evidence. Use the configured standards owner; do not infer a new Standards department. Keep one canonical record and link to project evidence rather than duplicating it.
folder_group_rules.Internal Projects: Internal company initiatives and project-specific tasks, decisions, and records. File by project context even when work is assigned across departments.
folder_group_rules.Client Projects: External/customer project records under explicit client and project access boundaries. File by project context even when work is assigned across departments.
folder_group_rules.Department Operations & References: Non-project department operations, miscellaneous records, registers, recurring reviews, tickets, approved reference links, and the team knowledge base.
folder_group_rules.access_and_assignment: Tasks and document records may be explicitly assigned to departments; assignment and folder placement do not grant read, edit, approval, or signing permission. The canonical backend enforces ownership, explicit authorization, classification, and client/internal boundaries. Audit views link to canonical records.

rules: Families are logical groups, not official numbers or required separate files
Requiredness is determined by accepted stage/customer/applicability contracts
Reuse software records; file export is a rendition

Place standards/templates and shared audit/QMS indexes in Common & Standards; place internal/client project records with their projects; place non-project operations and references in Department Operations & References
Audit indexes may link to canonical project evidence; do not make uncontrolled duplicate files
Task/document assignment and folder placement do not grant access
Preserve separate confidential scopes and unique subtypes when grouping
Cataloguing is not a prerequisite to complete all families before shipping the current flow
Reusable-asset master, project reuse/configuration, and as-built genealogy are subrecords within existing families, not additional family IDs or mandatory standalone files

items.scope: Controlled master asset revisions, project configuration/reuse assessment, change lineage and as-built genealogy are linked as subrecords within existing families. Reuse does not itself establish compatibility, qualify a design, or waive testing, customer/regulatory approval, or recertification; any tailored work requires a source-backed authorized decision.

Attach qualification/certificate evidence to the exact covered component/asset revision; separately track finished project/product certification for the exact integrated configuration and its own test, authority/lab, customer/market applicability, validity, and evidence. Component certification never implies finished-product certification.

EMF owns accepted outsourced PCBA receiving/traceability, line assembly/box-build, controlled firmware loading, and production functional checks. MMF owns mechanical fabrication, finishing, subassembly, and inspection. QA retains independent quality criteria and disposition. TST/EOL is not a separate current department; tests are assigned to the applicable process and authority. In-house bare-board fabrication and PCBA assembly remain out of scope.

items.topic: Inventory, reusable design, and plant asset boundaries
items.scope: Keep raw materials, purchased components/assemblies, configured WIP, consumables/MRO/packaging as stock-controlled items; revisioned designs as reusable engineering assets; and machinery/tooling/test/calibration/facility equipment as physical assets. Link BOMs and as-built genealogy to stock IDs/lots and compatible plant resources without treating assets as stock or selecting a BOM as a stock transaction.

stock_controlled_inventory: electronics components and accepted outsourced PCB assemblies
mechanical raw materials and purchased parts
inventory_object_model.reusable_engineering_assets: Revisioned design/configuration records; not on-hand stock. Their revision-specific BOMs link stock item IDs and approved supply.
inventory_object_model.plant_context: Electronics, mechanical, shared test/quality, and facility/work-center classifications are configurable metadata/views over authorized records, not duplicate ledgers.
inventory_object_model.transaction_boundary: Reuse/BOM selection does not reserve, receive, issue, procure, adjust, or post inventory. Those are explicit authorized transactions with movement audit and lot/serial genealogy.
